identification: Eight Tasmanian steel number plates: three Holiday Isle era (1976-98) blue on grey/white plates (AU-8006, CK-0351, and a matched pair DC-9397), plus VA-5201 (TAS, blue, 1970s) and three older black-on-white TAS plates (WGD-408, WSK-624, WJV-989). Ordinary registrations, no low numbers or personalised plates. Heavy rust on three.
